ranking.title: 🏆 General Models Ranking
ranking.info_rule1_text: Models are ranked first by the average of the ratings they received (1 to 5 stars). Gifted shows or shows marked as TBD do not affect the average.
ranking.info_rule2_text: With equal average ratings, the model with more shows is ranked higher.
ranking.colors_cost: Avg €/min: green if the model costs less per minute than your average, red if more (beyond ±10%); no color when close to the average.
ranking.colors_rating: Average Rating: in amber, to spot it at a glance.
ranking.colors_votes: Rating of each show (model card and history): green 5, teal 4, amber 3, red 1-2, grey not yet rated.
ranking.colors_missing: Not available: duration not recorded or €/min not computable (shows without duration or gifts).
